## Question 1

```{r check-robots}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "/fsb/directory/",
  domain = "miamioh.edu",
  bot = "*"
)
```

```{r departments}
department_names = c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information Systems & Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

department_paths = c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)
```

```{r scrape-and-combine}
scrape_department = function(dept_number) {

  webpage = rvest::read_html(paste0(
    "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/",
    department_paths[dept_number],
    "/all"
  ))

  people = webpage |>
    rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(3)")

  department_df = data.frame(
    department = department_names[dept_number],

    name = webpage |>
      rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(2)") |>
      rvest::html_element("img") |>
      rvest::html_attr("alt"),

    position = people |>
      rvest::html_element("i") |>
      rvest::html_text2(),

    website = people |>
      rvest::html_element("strong a") |>
      rvest::html_attr("href"),

    link_name = people |>
      rvest::html_element("strong a") |>
      rvest::html_text2()
  )

  # Use the linked name if the picture label is missing
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    department_df |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), name != ""),

    department_df |>
      dplyr::filter(is.na(name) | name == "") |>
      dplyr::mutate(name = link_name)
  ) |>
    dplyr::select(department, name, position, website)
}

# Run the function for all seven departments
fsb_directory = purrr::map_df(
  .x = 1:7,
  .f = scrape_department
)
```

## All Departments

```{r print-all-departments}
dplyr::glimpse(fsb_directory)
print(fsb_directory)
```

## Check for Missing Information

The following output should contain zero rows.

```{r missing-information}
fsb_directory |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(name) | name == "" |
    is.na(position) | position == "" |
    is.na(website) | website == ""
  )
```
